### Changed
- The `muster` and `muster-crds` chart READMEs no longer render a version badge (`chart.badgesSection` removed from both `README.md.gotmpl` files): a release PR bumping `Chart.yaml`'s `version` or `appVersion` no longer changes the checked-in `README.md`, so the helm-docs pre-commit hook no longer fails on it. ([giantswarm/devctl#2180](https://github.com/giantswarm/devctl/issues/2180))
